form.title: Pre-register your child in {two minutes}
form.intro: Fill in the form: your request goes straight to the school office, which will call you back.
form.privacy: Your answers are only shared with the school office and are erased after 12 months.
form.required: Fields marked with an asterisk are required.

parent.label: Parent or guardian's name
parent.error: Enter the parent or guardian's name.

form.errorSummary: The form is not complete: please correct the fields marked in red.
form.disclaimer: Pre-registration is not enrolment: the school office will contact you about the next steps.
form.template:
Hello, I would like to pre-register a student at %school%.

Student: %student%
Section: %section%
Stream: %stream%
Class requested: %className%
Parent or guardian: %parent%
Phone: %phone%

done.title: Your request is ready
done.sent: WhatsApp opens with your message. All you need to do is press Send.
done.noNumber: The school office's WhatsApp number is not online yet. Copy this message and pass it on to the school.

whatsappOnly.intro: Fill in the form: your request opens in WhatsApp, ready to send to the school office.
whatsappOnly.privacy: Your answers only go to WhatsApp: this site does not store them.

consent.label: I agree that the school may store this information to handle my request.
consent.error: Tick this box to send the request.

saved.title: Request received
saved.keep: Keep this number: the school office may ask for it.
saved.callback: The school office will call you back on %phone%.
saved.whatsapp: Also let them know on WhatsApp

failed.network: Sending failed: the connection was interrupted. Please try again in a moment.
failed.throttled: Several messages were just sent from this device. Please wait a quarter of an hour, or call the school office.
failed.invalid: Some information was not accepted. Check the form, then try again.
failed.server: The sending service is not responding right now.
